summary: ifTargetDied reads tracking.lastTarget; a self segment (attack/armor/heal/magic allySelf) rewrites lastTarget to the caster, so in chains like dmg -> attack(self, ifTargetDied) -> armor(self, ifTargetDied) only the first kill bonus applies. Native AddForKill on IncreaseAllStats / consecutive self steps grants all of them. Curated workaround used: ifCond castEnemyDied (7314, 9703 precedent; applied to 7165, 7294, 7484). Suggest: ifTargetDied binds to the last damage segment's target (or castTracking kill flag), then sweep other curated users of repeated ifTargetDied self segments.
repro: before sa-G fix: castSpell({key:'troop:6095', enemies:[1,1,1,1 hp]}) -> only atk+4 (armor/life/magic missing)
